headline: Re-derived 104 numbers from the five batch-1 rows files: 94 pass, 8 fail, 2 unverifiable from rows. The instrument gate (cold->null/0, warm->explicit non-null, repeat determinism) HOLDS. U2's 64-token tax law, U10's 64-boundary miss, and U5's quality arm reproduce exactly. U4b reproduces exactly but its 1792 cached tokens violate BOTH published forms of the 64-token law. U9's per-length TTFT deltas reproduce at L=1024 but NOT at the other five lengths from a fixed population (fill role switches from 'miss' to 'prime' at seq61), and U9's published p=0.0078 is wrong by a factor of 2 (the n=7 floor is 0.0156).

not_reproduced.recomputed: 348.1 / 692.9 / 1421.9 / 3054.9 / 7529.0 ms and deltas 260.9 / 587.7 / 1307.6 / 2915.6 / 7297.4 ms (statistics.median over role=='miss', length_target grouping)
not_reproduced.why: The trial rows switch their uncached-fill role from 'miss' to 'prime' at seq61 (L>=4096). Grouping by length_target with role=='miss' reproduces the published numbers only at L=2048 (349.25, published 349.2 as a truncation) and L=1024 (207.70, published 208.7); the other five lengths do not match under any grouping tried (length_target, observed prompt_tokens, modal L, mean vs median). The qualitative claim survives (hit TTFT is 0.031-0.42x of miss TTFT at all six lengths); the published decimals do not.

not_reproduced.claim: exact sign test p=0.0078 at every length
not_reproduced.recomputed: 2*(1/2^7) = 0.0156; and no length has 7 clean pairs (n=7 only arises if all 45+43 miss/hit rows are pooled)
not_reproduced.why: p=0.0078 is twice the smallest two-sided p attainable at n=7 under exact McNemar/sign testing. The number is arithmetically impossible for the stated test.
Exponents and r2 differ in the third decimal and the OLS ms/token slope differs, so the published decimals are not reproducible from these rows; the shape is.

not_reproduced.claim: cached_full_prefix_tokens 1792 on L=1925 prompts; 'Arm A shared prefix did hit'
not_reproduced.why: Both published forms of the 64-token tax law predict 1920 for L=1925 (1925%64=5 is a residue class U10 measured 0/15 misses in), yet all 12 U4b hit rows report 1792 = 7x256 -- a 128-token (6.7%) shortfall. So U4b's B/A=3.31 and C/A=1.00 reproduce from the rows, but they are computed on cache accounting that contradicts the tax law the other cells established, and U4b's handoff never noticed it.

not_reproduced.claim: 'tax law CONFIRMED' via 44 lengths 314-1550 + a 15,787-token chunked-prefill probe
not_reproduced.recomputed: unverifiable: 0 of U2's 44 lengths are multiples of 64 and the probe L=15787 is 15787%64=43
not_reproduced.why: floor(L/64) and (L-1)//64 are identical on every single U2 length, so U2's rows cannot distinguish the two forms; U9 later found they diverge at L%64==0 (cached=960 at L=1024). U2's 'CONFIRMED' is correct only for the population it tested; it does not license the law at multiples of 64.

overstated.claim: all 42 paired deltas positive; p=0.0078 at every length
overstated.reality: 38/41 same-salt pairs are positive and all 3 exceptions sit at L=1024, the L%64==0 boundary class U9 itself flags and U10 replicated 5/5; the minimum attainable p is 0.0156, not 0.0078.

overstated.claim: 'B/A=3.31 >= 1.5 -> fan-out to independent histories IS supported'
overstated.reality: Reproduces exactly (15400/4648 = 3.3133) but the same run's cached=1792 contradicts the 64-token tax law (expects 1920) and its two lost branches are the same phenomenon U10 could not explain. Characterise 3.31 as a measurement on a server whose accounting is not yet understood at this length, not as a clean cost ratio.

Both pairs reproduce correctly once attached to the right counts (10/10 pooled -> [0.6915,1.0]; 0/15 -> [0.0,0.218]; 5/5 and 0/5 per cell -> [0.4782,1.0] and [0.0,0.5218]). No numeric error; flagged only because two differently-labelled pairs sit in one evidence string.

unverified.why: Exists only as a report field G0.short_boundary; there is no sub-64 row in u2_rows.jsonl or u2_cache_rows.jsonl, so it cannot be recomputed from rows.

unverified.item: L=1024 ratio 0.414 and boundary-anomaly claim (cached=0 then 960)
unverified.why: Reproduces, but only because the 3 attempt-2 re-sends were folded in as hits; the attempt-1 rows for those reps are themselves misses. Reported as arithmetic coincidence, not as clean evidence.
u5_raw.jsonl has ONE shallow condition ('shared', 190 rows). The claim is true by construction and cannot be contradicted, so it proves nothing about a rendering difference.

The handoff's depth_effect block is not in the evidence I re-derived and the shallow arm is a single shared condition; the published discordant counts (13/24, 14/22, 16/22) do not match a shallow-vs-deep join I could construct.

unverified.why: Reproduces exactly (268.4 from 5 rows) but those rows have prompt_tokens 1021-1025 (salt jitter); the 'L=1024' label is the length_target, not the observed prompt length.

next_unit_hint: The batch-1 numbers are mostly sound; the drift is concentrated in U9 and U4b. Next unit should: (1) rebuild U9's analysis from u9_trials.jsonl keying on ROLE=='miss' vs 'prime' explicitly and re-emit the per-length table, sign test (p=0.0156 ceiling) and exponents -- do NOT cite 0.0078; (2) re-run U4b at a length that is neither a multiple of 64 nor exposes the 1920-vs-1792 discrepancy, or explain the 128-token shortfall, before any cost ratio is published; (3) treat U2's tax-law CONFIRMED as valid only for non-multiple-of-64 lengths; (4) the instrument gate and U10/U5 findings need no rework.
assumptions: The card's cells/U2/rows.jsonl does not exist; used cells/U2/u2_rows.jsonl (44 rows) plus u2_cache_rows.jsonl (88 rows).
The card's cells/U9 and cells/U4b directory names resolve to u9_trials.jsonl and rows.jsonl respectively.

U9 handoff labels its six lengths by observed prompt length (1024..31415); the rows key them by length_target (1024..32768), so joins are on length_target and the card text uses the card's 1024/2028/3955/7863/15701/31415 labels.

Fisher exact, McNemar exact and Clopper-Pearson were reimplemented with stdlib only (no scipy); CP was validated against U10's published bounds [0.6915,1.0]/[0.0,0.218]/[0.4782,1.0]/[0.0,0.5218], all four of which it reproduces to 4 dp.
